title: [main] Bug 648630 Movement Worksheet Creates Incorrect Warehouse Movement for FEFO Lot-Tracked Items
summary: Fixed availability calculation in Create Pick codeunit to exclude outbound quantities when calculating available inventory for warehouse movements of FEFO lot-tracked items, preventing the worksheet from selecting already-committed lots.
key_points: Corrected CalcTotalAvailQtyToPick to exclude picked-not-shipped quantities in outbound bins
Movement worksheet now selects correct FEFO lot instead of one fully committed to sales orders
Availability calculation now considers pending picks and outbound inventory when called from Movement Worksheet
Prevents movements from attempting to source stock from ship zone
Regression fix for lot-tracked items with existing picks and movements
quote: Movement Worksheet Creates Incorrect Warehouse Movement for FEFO Lot-Tracked Items When Picked-Not-Shipped and Pending Picks Exist.
